result.title: SkinAdvisor: An AI-Driven Decision Framework for Skin Production Planning via Multi-Modal Transformer Sales Forecasting
result.summary: Skins, cosmetic in-game items, are a primary revenue stream for modern online games, yet production decisions (which skins to make, when to release, how to price) remain driven by intuition and retrospective analytics. We present SkinAdvisor, an AI-driven decision framework for skin production planning, powered by SkinCast, a deployed multi-modal Transformer forecasting 180-day per-day sales trajectories for unreleased skins. SkinCast couples four encoders: a pretrained Informer for player-preference time series, a pretrained Player-Hero-Skin graph embedder for relational priors, and two lightweight Transformers for skin attributes and release context, fused through a shared backbone with a local-plus-global day-x positional encoding and decoded by an N-layer Informer in a single non-autoregressive pass. SkinAdvisor plugs these forecasts into a serving pipeline (Select -> Fill -> Infer -> Sales -> ROI -> Ranking) that ranks candidate skins by forecast-based ROI and supports multi-candidate comparison. The system has been in production for a full release cycle. Offline experiments show SkinCast reduces RMSE by ~20% over the strongest baseline (Informer) and ~60% over classical methods; stress tests on a 16-core CPU server confirm p99 latency under 8ms and peak throughput above 1100 rps. We report two deployment lessons: order-of-magnitude accuracy suffices for production decisions, and pretrained embeddings can leak temporal information, requiring season-based splitting to prevent.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 SkinAdvisor 皮肤生产决策框架，其核心 SkinCast 将预训练 Informer 时序编码器、玩家-英雄-皮肤图嵌入以及皮肤属性、发布上下文两路轻量 Transformer 经共享骨干融合，以非自回归方式单次解码未发布皮肤 180 天的逐日销量轨迹，并据此做 ROI 排序。
AI.relevance_reason: 其非自回归并行解码与局部加全局位置编码可能为并行生成 latent 推理状态提供线索，多模态先验的融合方式可供核查关系与任务信息如何进入内部表示；文中预训练嵌入泄漏时间信息的问题也提示需警惕捷径与贡献分配。
